text:
alex: Quick heads-up — main CI went red right after the merge. smoke/gpu-runloop job timed out at the serve-smoke step. Job: https://ci.redwood/runs/4829
ci-bot: [automated] build failed: step serve-smoke exited 1 after 5m30s. logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/4829#serve-smoke
maya: assigning to me, looked at logs — getting repeated "connection reset by peer" in the container when starting model-server.
sam: weird, the container image changed in r/1234 that touched the entrypoint. @maya is that the PR that merged?
maya: @sam yeah 1234 merged ~3m before the red. I'm pulling the image locally now.
lin: can someone rerun the pipeline for the PR? if it's transient maybe a rerun helps. I've seen this flake on infra side before.
alex: please don't revert yet — try a rerun of the specific job: `ci rerun 4829 --job serve-smoke`
maya: reran job, still fails. attaching minimal log snippet:
``` 
E0303 12:02:13 model-server] failed to bind socket: address already in use
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/server.py", line 78, in start
    server.bind(addr)
OSError: [Errno 98] Address already in use
```
sam: hmm that error lines up with change to entrypoint adding a background process. @maya can you try starting with `--no-detach` flag to keep single process?
maya: trying flag now, will post results.
ci-bot: rerun scheduled by maya (job 4831)
maya: flag fixed startup locally, pushing quick hotfix to revert detach behavior (PR 1250), can we canary on a dedicated run before full rollout?
alex: agreed. pinging infra on quick canary: @lin can you help with canary run and watch logs? :eyes:
lin: on it, starting canary run 4832, will report back in ~5m
maya: thanks all, if canary green we'll merge 1250 and we should add an e2e coverage for detached processes to avoid this.
